summary: Learn platform engineering, IDP design, golden paths, Kubernetes, GitOps, and DORA metrics. Build a practical roadmap with TrainingCred.
lede: Platform engineering training covers designing internal developer platforms that give software teams reliable self-service delivery workflows. For platform and DevOps engineers, cloud architects, and software engineering leaders, it addresses how to shape platform services around developer needs and production responsibilities. You’ll practise mapping developer journeys, designing Backstage golden paths, structuring Kubernetes and Terraform/GitOps workflows, and using delivery and reliability measures to guide platform adoption.
audienceIntro: Platform engineering is most useful when the people designing the platform understand both developer workflow friction and production responsibility. This course suits technical practitioners and leaders who need to shape an IDP, improve self-service delivery, or govern a platform product across teams.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to software delivery, cloud infrastructure, DevOps workflows, or site reliability operations. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, containers, and either Kubernetes or infrastructure as code will help, but you do not need to administer a production cluster. No programming is required for completion. Advanced topics such as Crossplane, Open Policy Agent, OpenTelemetry, and AI-assisted platform operations are taught at conceptual and operational application level, while platform canvases, workflow maps, golden paths, dashboards, and roadmaps receive hands-on design treatment.
